route.title: Dated opening word and delay claim
route.marker: Hag.1.1 supplies the date, word-event formula, named addressees, and saying introduction; Hag.1.2 supplies the introduced community claim, and a WLC-family pe follows before the renewed word event at Hag.1.3.
route.rationale: Keep the dated formula with the community claim it grammatically introduces; the closing paragraph mark and renewed word event make 1:2 the safe endpoint.
route.counter: The date and addressee notice has a recoverable framing function and governs more than the quoted claim, but that metadata function does not outweigh its syntactic dependence.
route.basis: The grammatical introduction is incomplete without the quoted saying it introduces. Syntactic completion, paragraph closure after 1:2, and the renewed word-event formula at 1:3 converge on a two-verse opening unit.
route.guard: Do not use the date and addressee frame to decide authorship, chronology, office, or Persian-period history.

route.title: Paneled-house accusation and futility
route.marker: The renewed word event at Hag.1.3 introduces the paneled-house accusation, consider-your-ways summons, and cumulative sowing, eating, drinking, clothing, and wages register through 1:6; a WLC-family pe follows.
route.rationale: Preserve the accusation, consider summons, and futility outcomes as one result-bearing oracle rather than detaching its memorable scarcity list.
route.rejected: Hag.1.3-Hag.1.5 plus Hag.1.6-Hag.1.6; Hag.1.4-Hag.1.6; Hag.1.3-Hag.1.11; Separate chunks for individual futility outcomes
route.counter: The divine-speech formula near the consider summons and the memorable list create internal rhetorical turns, while the repeated consider formula at 1:7 links both confrontation movements.
route.basis: Frame, accusation, evaluation summons, and futility consequences form one accusation-and-result oracle before the repeated speech and consider formulas at 1:7.
route.guard: Do not detach the futility register as an individual prosperity, finance, vocation, or moral diagnosis.

route.title: Building commission and drought explanation
route.marker: Repeated divine-speech and consider-your-ways formulas introduce the mountain, wood, and build commands; disappointed expectation, explanatory clauses, withheld yield, and the drought register continue through Hag.1.11, followed by a WLC-family samekh.
route.rationale: Commission, disappointed expectation, causal explanation, and drought register answer one another and reach their marked closure together at 1:11.
route.rejected: Hag.1.7-Hag.1.8 plus Hag.1.9-Hag.1.11; Hag.1.8-Hag.1.8; Hag.1.9-Hag.1.11; Hag.1.3-Hag.1.11; Separate chunks for drought-list members
route.counter: The imperative cluster at 1:8 and the expectation-and-explanation turn at 1:9 are recoverable internal movements.
route.basis: Commission, failed expectation, causal explanation, and drought result are mutually dependent movements of one oracle with marked closure.
route.guard: Do not isolate the build command or drought list as institutional authority, environmental causation, or prosperity doctrine.

route.title: Obedience, assurance, stirring, work, and date coda
route.marker: Narrated obedience begins at Hag.1.12, messenger assurance responds at 1:13, divine stirring and work continue through 1:14, and the prepositional date in 1:15 completes when the reported work occurred before the fresh dated word event at 2:1.
route.rationale: The bare date at 1:15 identifies when the narrated work occurred, so it remains a dependent coda inside the obedience, assurance, stirring, and work response.
route.counter: The WLC-family pe after 1:14 is genuine evidence for a dependent date-coda seam, and the messenger assurance at 1:13 is a distinct embedded speech.
route.basis: The bare date phrase lacks a fresh word-event formula and is syntactically and narratively dependent on the work report. Keeping it with 1:12-14 preserves response, assurance, stirring, work, and chronology together.
route.guard: Do not surface the presence assurance as an unconditional slogan or the date coda as independent chronological authority.

route.title: Former-glory question and encouragement
route.marker: The dated word event and addressee command introduce the former-glory questions, threefold be-strong and work summons, covenant and presence language, Spirit reassurance, and fear-not close; a WLC-family samekh follows Hag.2.5.
route.rationale: Former-glory questions, threefold strengthening, work command, and covenant-presence reassurance comprise one encouragement child before the marked 2:5 seam.
route.rejected: Hag.2.1-Hag.2.3 plus Hag.2.4-Hag.2.5; Hag.2.4-Hag.2.5; Hag.2.4-Hag.2.4; Hag.2.1-Hag.2.9
route.counter: The encouragement at 2:4 and compressed covenant-and-Spirit relation at 2:5 are internal turns, while the causal opening at 2:6 keeps this child dependent on the full 2:1-9 oracle.
route.basis: Question, encouragement, work command, and reassurance form a complete dated encouragement movement with marked closure at 2:5.
route.guard: Do not detach strength, work, covenant, Spirit, presence, or fear-not wording as generic promises.

route.title: Shaking, glory, and peace promise
route.marker: A renewed divine-speech formula and yet-once-more expression begin the shaking register; heavens, earth, sea, nations, valuable things, silver, gold, latter house glory, and peace continue through Hag.2.9, followed by a WLC-family pe.
route.rationale: Creation and nations shaking moves through resources to latter house glory and peace; splitting its statements would sever the promise from its stated result.
route.rejected: Hag.2.6-Hag.2.7; Hag.2.6-Hag.2.8 plus Hag.2.9-Hag.2.9; Hag.2.6-Hag.2.7 plus Hag.2.8-Hag.2.9; Hag.2.9-Hag.2.9; Hag.2.1-Hag.2.9
route.counter: The causal opening links backward to 2:1-5, and repeated speech formulas plus the declaration at 2:8 create internal turns.
route.basis: The shaking movement resolves specifically in house glory and peace; the intervening silver-and-gold statement functions within that resolution rather than starting an independent oracle.
route.guard: Do not use shaking, nations, valuable things, silver, gold, glory, or peace to decide translation, fulfillment, history, or prosperity.

route.title: Priestly questions and prophetic application
route.marker: The dated word event commands inquiry of the priests; the holiness-contact question and answer at Hag.2.12, corpse-impurity question and answer at 2:13, and Haggai's application to people, work, and offering at 2:14 form one instructional sequence before the retrospective summons at 2:15.
route.rationale: The two priestly cases are intentionally paired and receive their literary result in Haggai application, so no answer or application can safely surface alone.
route.counter: Each priestly exchange is formally complete, 2:14 changes from dialogue to application, and no WLC-family paragraph marker closes after 2:14.
route.basis: The paired cases are deliberately asymmetrical, and the prophetic application states their literary result. Neither answer safely represents the passage without the other question and the application.
route.guard: Do not surface either priestly answer as a contextless ritual, legal, ethical, or doctrinal rule.

route.title: Retrospective shortfall and failed return
route.marker: The first consider-from-this-day-and-backward summons introduces pre-foundation shortfall, reduced stores, blight, mildew, hail, and failed return through Hag.2.17; the consider command restarts explicitly at 2:18 with a newly specified foundation-day threshold.
route.rationale: The first consider summons carries a complete negative retrospective through shortfall, agricultural strikes, and failed return before the command and time threshold restart.
route.rejected: Hag.2.15-Hag.2.19; Separate chunks for individual agricultural losses; Hag.2.15-Hag.2.16 plus Hag.2.17-Hag.2.17
route.counter: This is the negative first half of a larger reversal whose blessing arrives only in 2:18-19; it must retain the 2:15-19 parent.
route.basis: The negative retrospective has its own summons, temporal orientation, cumulative failure register, and failed-return conclusion. The repeated command and changed temporal threshold at 2:18 are stronger than a merely stylistic internal turn.
route.guard: Do not detach crop losses or failed return from the dated retrospective and the blessing reversal parent.

route.title: Foundation-day hinge and blessing reversal
route.marker: The repeated consider summons names the foundation-day threshold; absent seed and unproductive plants lead to the from-today blessing reversal, and a WLC-family samekh follows Hag.2.19.
route.rationale: The repeated consider command and foundation-day threshold open a blessing child whose crop inventory, reversal promise, and paragraph closure complete at 2:19.
route.counter: The child cannot establish the force of its reversal without the shortfall and failed-return history in 2:15-17, so isolated retrieval is prohibited by mandatory parent hydration.
route.basis: The doubled command, explicit foundation-day threshold, inventory question, reversal promise, and paragraph closure establish a coherent dependent blessing child. The evidence is not treated as tied because both form and temporal orientation restart at 2:18.
route.guard: Do not surface from-today blessing as an unconditional prosperity, agricultural, chronology, or temple-legitimacy claim.

route.title: Second same-day Zerubbabel oracle
route.marker: The word comes a second time on the same day at Hag.2.20; direct address to Zerubbabel develops through creation shaking, kingdom and chariot overthrow, mutual sword, servant address, signet image, election statement, and the final speech formula at 2:23.
route.rationale: The explicit second same-day word governs the overthrow catalogue and its servant-signet culmination through the terminal speech formula.
route.counter: Hag.2.23 changes from broad overthrow imagery to highly retrievable personal servant, signet, and election language, but it is the addressed culmination rather than an independent identity oracle.
route.basis: The explicit second-word frame, named addressee, overthrow sequence, servant-and-signet culmination, election statement, and terminal speech formula form one complete closing oracle.
route.guard: Do not detach servant, signet, or chosen language to decide royal or messianic identity, office, history, or fulfillment.

dissents.rationale: The WLC-family pe after 1:14 supports a dependent date-coda seam, although the bare date cannot safely surface alone.
The former-glory questions shift to threefold encouragement at 2:4, but question and reassurance remain one dated oracle.
The causal opening at 2:6 continues the reassurance in 2:5, so the complete 2:1-9 oracle remains mandatory despite surfaced children.
No paragraph marker closes after 2:14 and the retrospective continues the dated word event, preserving the whole parent while local form changes surface.
No paragraph marker follows 2:17, closure occurs after 2:19, and both phases form one shortfall-to-blessing reversal.
The blessing child receives its force from the shortfall and failed return; mandatory parent hydration preserves the canonical retrieval objection.
